---
title: "check-note-sheet-rows.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, warn-only check that flags a note-sheet table row
holding more than one concept.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-10-22) is that a note sheet gives each concept its own row:
one formula and one short label, with no prose.
This implements
[gha#1164](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1164).

The check reads pipe tables (`| label | formula |`) in the files `globs` matches,
by default `*note-sheet*.qmd`, and reports a row the pull request adds when:

- the label holds notation,
  unless the label is a link to the term's definition;
- the label joins two concepts with a comma or "and";
- one cell holds two formulas joined by a comma, a semicolon or "and".

A label that ends in `, ... form`, `version` or `case`,
such as `Sample MSE, matrix form`,
names one concept in a second form, in a row of its own, and is not flagged.
Rows inside code fences are ignored.

The check is diff-scoped:
an added line whose exact text was also deleted in the same diff counts as moved.
With no base ref, or when the diff cannot be computed,
it skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree,
unless `whole-tree` asks for that.

## Inputs

- `globs`: space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (default `*note-sheet*.qmd`).
- `paths-ignore`: comma- or newline-separated glob patterns to skip.
- `fail`: fail the workflow on a finding (default `false`, warning annotations only).
- `whole-tree`: scan every matching file in full (default `false`).
- `python-version`: Python version to set up (default `3.x`).

The prose rule is PSW's
"Give each concept in a note sheet its own row".
